subject.title: Admin deletion request: remove three moderation-hidden test skills

question: After verifying production ownership and retention requirements, should staff permanently hard-delete all three named moderation-hidden listings and their dependent discovery records?
rationale: The operation crosses an intentional admin-only boundary and irreversibly removes records that may contain moderation evidence, so automation cannot authorize it.

options.title: Verify and hard-delete
options.body: Confirm the requester owns all three listings and no retention hold applies, then perform audited deletion and verify dependent records are gone.

options.title: Retain hidden records
options.body: Leave the listings unavailable if moderation or audit policy requires preserving their records, and explain that constraint to the requester.

recommendation.title: Verify and hard-delete
recommendation.body: Confirm the requester owns all three listings and no retention hold applies, then perform audited deletion and verify dependent records are gone.

likelyOwner.reason: Their recent merged history owns the owner-deletion and hard-delete behavior in the central skills backend.
